summary: ImgCompress is a containerised image processing utility that runs locally via Docker. It provides capabilities for compression, format conversion, resizing, batch operations, and local AI-driven background removal without sending data to external cloud services.
goodFor: This is suitable if you need to process large batches of images locally while keeping your data entirely self-contained and free from third-party API dependencies.
watchOut: Local AI background removal tasks can demand significant local hardware resources, and the project has a modest community footprint with an average maintenance posture.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your input and output image directories and place the container behind a reverse proxy if you require remote access.
